title: RMACD Intent Decision Record
description: The durable evidence artifact produced by every adjudication. Simultaneously the audit record and the precedent memory that feeds likelihood. See docs/intent-specification.md §9.

intent_id.description: The adjudicated intent. This is the join key between the adjudication and interception audit trails (N-45).

action_pattern_key.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of exactly the six fields in specification §6.1.

base_level.description: The level the framework's effective matrix required, before escalation. Sourced from the §3.1 matrix as adjusted by the bound profile; never from a second matrix (N-13).

computed_level.description: The level after escalation, composition floor and immutable floor. Never less restrictive than base_level (N-14). Escalation saturates at elevated_approval; prohibited arises only from the pinned or extended floor (N-14a).

escalation_factors.description: Every factor that fired, with its step contribution. Empty when the computed level equals the base level.

impact_basis.description: The impact axis used. Classification by default, or the organization's declared substitute (N-16).

profile_id.description: The bound profile that supplied the permission ceiling. Adjudication never grants beyond it (N-20).

likelihood_weights_version.description: Reproducibility input: the version of the effective likelihood weight table (N-18, N-21).

log_epoch.description: Reproducibility input: the decision-log state precedent was computed against. Adjudication is deterministic but not stateless (N-21).

grant_ref.description: The grant that discharged approval, if any. A grant discharges; it never lowers computed_level (N-27).

disposition.description: A human decision recorded against the computed level.

prohibition_source.description: Required when computed_level is prohibited. 'pinned' is the framework §12.5 floor and can never be removed or narrowed; 'extended' is an organization's own declared prohibition, which extends the floor outward but never shrinks it. Escalation is never a source: likelihood saturates at elevated_approval and cannot reach prohibited (N-14a, N-14b, N-44).

reconciliation.description: Attached after execution. Absent means unreconciled — which must never be recorded as a match (N-49).

audit_record_id.description: The interception-side audit record this was joined against.

discrepancies.description: Fields where the executed action differed from the declared intent. The comparison set is fixed by N-47: scope is included so a self-declared blast radius is checked rather than trusted (N-51).

allOf.$comment: N-44: a prohibited decision must say which kind of prohibition it is.

autonomyLevel.description: Framework §2.4 autonomy level. Intents add no oversight vocabulary.

factor.description: The five likelihood factors of specification §5.4, plus the fail-closed factor of N-6 and the composition floor of N-11.

steps.description: Escalation steps contributed. Never negative: no factor may reduce oversight (N-19).
